text:
morgan: Quick PSA — release window opens tomorrow 09:00 PT. Before cutoff please make sure your release-note one-liners follow the template below. We have an automated linter that will comment on PRs and mark entries that are missing PR links or component tags. Short checklist: one sentence, component in [brackets], PR or issue link, and avoid long paragraphs.

raj: Where's the canonical template? can we add it to the PR template too?

morgan: Good call. Adding to PR template after this. Template (use as a single line):
```
[component] Brief description of change (why it matters). See PR #1234.
```
Example correct entry:
```
[ingest] Reduce tokenization memory by streaming chunks; fixes OOM on big files. See PR #4821.
```
Use :sparkles: sparingly (only for public-facing features).

elaine: Does the linter auto-fail the release if someone forgets the PR number? or just comments?

release-bot: release-bot: The linter will add a comment on the PR and flag the release-entry as "needs format". It will not block merges but the entry will be excluded from the automated release notes until fixed. You can run the local check with `tools/release-note-lint --staged`.

sophie: ok I'll update my PR now — missed the [telemetry] tag, thanks for the heads up.

kevin: Is there a character limit we should aim for? some of our one-liners are ~3 sentences.

morgan: Aim for ~120-160 chars ideally. If it needs more context, link an internal changelog or the PR body but keep the release line short.

raj: For backports: should the entry include both original PR and backport PR numbers?

morgan: Good question. Put the backport PR in parentheses after the main PR: `See PR #4821 (backport #4890)`. Backports that are only fixes and don't change user-visible behavior can use the same one-liner.

elaine: If someone wants me to quick-review entries for tone/clarity, ping me. I can do a 10-min sweep after cutoff.

kevin: Thanks — running `git grep "\[.*\]" docs/ CHANGES.md || true` helped me find missing tags earlier. Sharing that in case others want a quick grep.

morgan: Nice. I'll also add a short checklist to the release PR template: 1) one-liner present 2) component tag 3) PR link 4) owner assigned.

sophie: :thumbsup: will fix mine now.

release-bot: release-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated lint will run on PRs targeting `release/*` and post results immediately. If you see `needs format` in the release dashboard, please update.

morgan: Last note — if you intentionally omit a one-liner (internal-only fix), add `#internal` at the start of the PR body so the linter knows to skip it.

raj: great, thanks morgan. I'll nudge a couple owners to update before 09:00.

kevin: copy, thanks!
